title: Compliance Ask Translator and Impact Classifier for Enterprise Legal Review
creator: Lina García
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit heterogeneous security and compliance requests (SOC2/ISO scopes, GDPR/DPA residency questions, HIPAA clauses, third-party vendor questionnaires) in formats ranging from short emails to complex RFI PDFs. Current intake requires heavy manual interpretation by PM and Legal, causing long SLAs and inconsistent prioritization.

Goal: Build a lightweight 'Compliance Ask Translator' that turns incoming customer compliance requests into a standardized, machine-readable checklist and an impact classifier that scores requests by engineering effort, legal risk, and delivery SLA. The output will feed an automated routing decision to Legal, Security, Dedicated Sales, or Solutions Engineering.

Scope:
- Ingest: email text, pasted questionnaire snippets, or uploaded PDF (text-extracted).
- Translate: map free-form asks to canonical requirement buckets (e.g., SOC2-logs, encryption-at-rest, data-residency-by-region, HIPAA-BAA-needed).
- Classify: produce a 3-axis score: engineering-impact (0-5), legal-risk (low/medium/high), SLA-sensitivity (normal/urgent/contractual).
- Output: JSON-like checklist, short human-readable summary for triage inbox, and suggested owner queue.
- Integration: wire to intake ticketing (existing intake queue), and provide a short view in the Console intake dashboard for PMs.

Out of scope for initial iteration: automated remediation, full PDF parsing for scanned images (OCR improvements are a separate ticket), and SLA negotiation automation.

Success metrics:
- Reduce initial manual categorization time per ask by >= 60% within 3 months.
- Increase correct owner routing to Legal/Security on first pass to >= 85%.
- Demonstrate triage SLA median from receipt to owner-assigned <= 24 hours for new requests routed through the translator.
acceptance_criteria: Incoming requests are normalized to a canonical checklist with >= 80% mapping accuracy against a ground-truth set of 200 historical asks.
Impact classifier produces engineering-impact scores with Pearson correlation >= 0.6 against engineering estimates on a 50-sample validation set.
System creates a recommended owner and suggested SLA that matches Legal triage decision in >= 85% of cases during pilot.
Generated summary and checklist appear in the intake ticket within 5 minutes of submission for text and extracted-PDF inputs.
PM and Legal reviewers can edit the translated checklist and submit corrections, which are captured for iterative model improvement.
tasks: Collect and label 200 historical security/compliance asks from ticket archive
Design canonical requirement taxonomy with Legal and Security (workshop 1)
Prototype translation heuristics + small LLM prompt templates for mapping
Build a light-weight classifier (rules + model) for engineering-impact scoring
Integrate translator output into intake ticket UI and add edit/feedback controls
Run 4-week pilot with 3 enterprise accounts and measure routing accuracy
Document operational runbook and error handling for unmapped asks

notes: Pilot will target enterprise accounts with active compliance workflows and at least one open DPA/GDPR question. We will log false negatives where translator misses high-risk asks and prioritize taxonomy gaps. Consider adding a later experiment to surface estimated budget/effort bands to customers during presales.
